title_rule: Phase 3 follow-up of the Paul Walker car map Short (4.2x baseline); answers 'gta 6 car dealership' / 'gta 6 buy cars'
short_description:
Is there a car dealership in GTA 6? No: you can't buy cars like in GTA V. To own one, steal the car you want and register it; guides list 19 Pay 'n' Sprays that do it, from Key Lento to Port Gellhorn. Garages to keep them in are in the Vice City Real Estate app. No story spoilers.

Sources: GTABase, Game8, TheClick, GameRant.

Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides).
